info.name: Latin & Afro
info.description: Clave, salsa, bossa nova, samba, latin house, an amapiano song and an afrobeat song.

songs.name: Amapiano
songs.description: An amapiano / afro house song in D minor at 113 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, groove, break, afro house and outro on the four Amapiano patterns, over Dm9, Gm9, B flat maj9 and Am7. The piano's filter opens over the intro and a beat of silence lets the log drum drop in; the log drum's climb at the end of each phrase is thrown into the echo; the afro house part brings the marimba in after four measures, and over the outro the piano fades away.

songs.name: Afrobeat
songs.description: An afrobeat song in D dorian at 110 BPM, all synth sounds: intro, groove, break, horns and outro on the four Afrobeat patterns, over Dm7 and G7. The bell comes in after two measures; in the groove the organ joins the guitar after four measures; the break leaves the bass and the congas with the drums; the horns' last phrase throws into the echo each time, and over the outro the hats thin out.

patterns.name: Latin House
patterns.description: Latin house, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on every & with a 4e-&-a run, syncopated clap over 2 beats, open hat on each &; low cowbell roll every 8 passes, pitched crash accents every 4.

patterns.name: Son Clave
patterns.description: Latin, 1 measure: 3-2 son clave on the clap over a four-on-the-floor kick, snare on 1&, 1a, 3e and 3&, closed hat on each &; pitched 16th toms on 4 every 6 passes.

patterns.name: Salsa
patterns.description: Salsa, 1 measure: congas and low congas in a tumbao, syncopated snare and cowbell, 16th tambourine, open hat pairs, kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4&, mono bass on 1, 1a, 2&, 3, 3a and 4&.

patterns.name: Bossa Nova
patterns.description: Bossa nova, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2& and 3, snare on 2, 3& and 4&, cowbell on 1, 2&, 3 and 4, 8th hats, toms on 3& and 4&; 16th tom pickup on 1 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Bossa Pizzicato
patterns.description: Bossa nova, 4 measures: plucked strings comping Cmaj7, Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7 on 1, 2& and 3&, the top note softer than the root.

patterns.name: Bossa Nova Clave
patterns.description: Bossa nova, 2 measures: kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4& (a dotted quarter and an eighth), cross-stick on the bossa clave 3-2 (1, 2&, 4 | 2, 3&), 8th hats with the off-beats soft, pedal hat on 2 and 4.

patterns.name: Bossa Nova Shaker
patterns.description: Bossa nova, 2 measures: kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4&, cross-stick on the bossa clave 2-3 (2, 3& | 1, 2&, 4), 16th shaker accented on the beat and its a, pedal hat on 2 and 4.

patterns.name: Amapiano Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Amapiano demo, 4 measures in D minor at 113 BPM, all synth sounds: a soft kick, a heavily swung shaker and cabasa, the amapiano rimshot pushed around beats 2 and 4, and bell piano chords (Dm9, Gm9, B flat maj9, Am7) on syncopated hits.

patterns.name: Amapiano Groove
patterns.description: The groove of the Amapiano demo, 4 measures in D minor at 113 BPM: the intro with a clap on 2 and 4 and the log drum, an 808 low tom tuned and saturated, playing the bass line on syncopated 16ths and climbing at the end of measure 4.

patterns.name: Amapiano Break
patterns.description: The break of the Amapiano demo, 4 measures in D minor: no kick, a warm pad under the piano, the shaker, and the log drum only in measures 2 and 4.

patterns.name: Amapiano Afro House
patterns.description: The afro house part of the Amapiano demo, 4 measures in D minor at 113 BPM: a firmer kick, high and low congas in interlocking patterns, a marimba riff in ping-pong delay, the shaker, cabasa and clap, the log drum lower in the mix and the piano on the first hit of each measure.

patterns.name: Batucada
patterns.description: Samba batucada, 1 measure: kick on each beat and its a, snare and clap syncopations over 2 beats, 16th hats with a gap on 2 and 4, open hat on 2 and 4; cowbell pickup on 4 every 4 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Samba Groove
patterns.description: Samba on a drum kit, 1 measure: kick on each beat and its a, the beats 2 and 4 louder (the surdo), rimshot on the teleco-teco (1, 1&, 2e, 2a, 3e, 4, 4&), 16th hats accented on the beat.

patterns.name: Samba Escola
patterns.description: Samba school, 2 measures: low surdo on 2 and 4 with a soft pickup on the a before, higher surdo on 1 and 3, caixa in 16ths pushing on the a, tamborim on the teleco-teco, a two-tone agogo on it, 16th ganza accented on the beat.

patterns.name: Afrobeat Intro
patterns.description: The intro and outro of the Afrobeat demo, 4 measures in D dorian at 110 BPM, all synth sounds: the kick on 1, the & of 2, the & of 3 and the e of 4, ghost 16ths on the snare around 2 and 4, hats with an open hat on the & of 2 and 4, a bell pattern three against four and a shekere in 16ths.

patterns.name: Afrobeat Groove
patterns.description: The groove of the Afrobeat demo, 4 measures in D dorian at 110 BPM: the drums with a bass riff on D, up a fourth for the G measures, a muted clavinet line in 16ths and organ stabs of Dm7 and G7 on the & of 2 and 4.

patterns.name: Afrobeat Break
patterns.description: The break of the Afrobeat demo, 4 measures in D dorian: the drums with high and low congas interlocking and the bass riff alone.

patterns.name: Afrobeat Horns
patterns.description: The horn section of the Afrobeat demo, 4 measures in D dorian at 110 BPM: the groove with the congas and a horn line in octaves, a call in the first measure answered in the third, and a falling phrase to close.
